name: College
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of grounding one's education and life path in the fear of the Lord, which is the foundation of true knowledge and wisdom, as Proverbs 1:7 and 9:10 teach. The pursuit of learning, including attending college, should be accompanied by meditation on God's law and reliance on His guidance, ensuring success and courage in all endeavors (Joshua 1:8-9). Psalm 119:105 highlights that God's Word provides illumination for every step, making it essential for students to remain anchored in Scripture as they navigate their academic and spiritual journeys. Furthermore, Proverbs 22:6 underscores the value of early instruction in the way of the Lord, which prepares individuals to remain steadfast in their faith throughout life.
